caption: The drawing consists of three vertical rectangular panels, each filled with horizontal rows of decorative patterns resembling embroidery stitches. The patterns are drawn in various colors, including green, blue, red, pink, brown, black, orange, purple, and yellow. Each row features a different design, such as zigzag lines, chevrons, interlocking diamonds, stylized flowers, and sequences of geometric or organic shapes. The left panel includes motifs such as leaf-like forms, starbursts, and arrow shapes, primarily in green, blue, brown, orange, and red hues. The center panel features patterns resembling vines, buds, criss-crossed lines, stylized blossoms, and leaf motifs, using similar colors, with additional pink and red. The right panel includes patterns such as stepped zigzags, connected diamonds, dots, small triangles, parallel lines, and repeated botanical shapes, presented in blue, green, yellow, pink, and purple. The panels are set against a pale or off-white background, with each patterned row separated by empty space, and the arrangement is organized and symmetrical. The bottom right corner includes a handwritten name, “Edith Fournier.”
title: Samples of Stitching
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
